children: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd. on Monday said its wholly owned subsidiary, ACME Greentech Sixteen Pvt. Ltd., has signed a 25-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with Rewa Ultra Mega Solar Ltd. (RUMSL) for a 220 MW solar project integrated with a battery energy storage system (BESS) at Morena Solar Park in Madhya Pradesh.
The project, identified as Unit II, has a tariff of ₹2.764 per unit, the company said in a regulatory filing.
The scheduled commercial operation date (SCOD) for the project is December 31, 2027. The PPA will remain in force for 25 years from the date of signing.

ACME Solar said the contract is domestic in nature and that neither its promoter group nor its group companies have any interest in the entity awarding the contract. It added that the agreement does not constitute a related-party transaction.
ACME Solar raises FY27 battery storage target

In a separate development, ACME Solar has raised its cumulative battery energy storage system commissioning target for FY27 to 12 GWh from 10 GWh, after the segment emerged as a significant contributor to revenue and profits in the July-September quarter.

The renewable energy independent power producer (IPP) expects its BESS business to account for 30-50% of revenue over the next two years, supported by new long-term PPAs and rising demand for dispatchable power.

Nikhil Dhingra, joint managing director and CEO of ACME Solar Holdings, said battery storage contributed 32% of the company's revenue and a similar share of its profits in the second quarter. He added that the business had structurally changed the company's earnings profile.
Dhingra expects demand for battery storage to remain strong as India's peak power deficit drives demand for more long-term PPAs.
ACME Solar Holdings shares closed at ₹403.25 on the BSE on November 16, down 2.68%, or ₹11.10, from the previous close.

title: ACME Solar signs PPA for 220 MW solar project with battery storage in Madhya Pradesh
